acceptable_paraphrases: all four sides have the same length
the opposite sides are equal in length
critical_errors: only one pair of parallel sides
misconceptions: rhombus is the same as rectangle
a rhombus has four right angles
a parallelogram has a line of symmetry
grading_notes: If the statement correctly identifies that all sides are equal, it's a rhombus and if not then it is a rectangle. If it states that all interior angles are 90°, it might be either a rectangle or parallelogram, but if no line of symmetry exists, then it's a parallelogram.
